# Build stages

One page per stage of the [roadmap](../roadmap.md). Start with stage 0, the MVP ([full MVP guide](../mvp.md)). The [bench rig](../bench-rig.md) is a separate test build.

- [Stage 0: MVP: one carriage, one fixed eight-channel pipette, passive deck](stage-0.md)
- [Stage 1: second carriage B with a fixed single-channel 0.5-10 uL pipette](stage-1.md)
- [Stage 2: plate gripper and lid handling](stage-2.md)
- [Stage 3: deck modules one at a time under the module standard (pitch 132 x 110, insert 130 x 108 x 5, 4 x M4, 2 x D4)](stage-3.md)
- [Stage 4: thermocycler TC-1 at F1 with its lid park at A1](stage-4.md)
- [Stage 5: exchangeable tools and the dock](stage-5.md)
- [Stage 6: cameras, tip supply towers and tip parking](stage-6.md)
- [Stage 7: depth upgrades S -> M -> L (and weighing, which only L's row D carries)](stage-7.md)
